articles.title: Christina Applegate Says Her MS Was Misdiagnosed
articles.que_paso: Actress Christina Applegate, who received a multiple sclerosis diagnosis in 2021, was recently told by a physician that the diagnosis was incorrect, overturning the earlier medical assessment. The clarification came after she sought further medical evaluation, and it underscores ongoing uncertainty about her health status.
datos: Christina Applegate was diagnosed with multiple sclerosis in 2021.
She is an American actress known for roles in "Dead to Me" and "Married... with Children".
A doctor later informed her that she does not have multiple sclerosis.
The reversal was reported in an interview published on October 21, 2026.
articles.conclusion: The case illustrates the potential for misdiagnosis in complex neurological conditions and suggests patients should consider second opinions to verify serious diagnoses.

articles.title: YouTube might be testing hiding the dislike button
articles.que_paso: YouTube is currently testing a UI change that places the dislike button inside the three‑dot menu instead of next to the like button, as reported by users who posted screenshots on X and Reddit. The test follows earlier moves that hid the public dislike count in 2021 and removed the button from Shorts earlier this year.
datos: The test was first reported by technology site 9to5Google.
At least two X users shared screenshots showing the dislike button in the three‑dot submenu.
A Reddit user posted an image where the dislike button was absent.
YouTube hid the public dislike count on videos in 2021 to protect creators from harassment, though creators still see the count.
YouTube removed the dislike button from Shorts earlier in 2024, directing users to the three‑dot menu.
articles.conclusion: If the button becomes harder to access, fewer viewers may register dislikes, potentially skewing engagement metrics and limiting creators’ feedback loops.

articles.title: As Alberta Rejects Canada Separatism, Carney Gets Much of the Credit
articles.que_paso: Canada’s prime minister, Mark Carney, persuaded the province of Alberta to stay in the federation by pledging a new pipeline and intensifying his campaign, which halted the province’s recent separatist drive.
datos: Mark Carney is the Prime Minister of Canada.
Alberta is Canada’s most conservative province.
Carney pledged to build a pipeline for Alberta.
The campaign resulted in Alberta rejecting separatism.
The separatist effort had been gaining momentum before Carney’s intervention.
articles.conclusion: The episode shows that concrete infrastructure promises can decisively influence regional political movements, offering a practical lesson for leaders aiming to preserve national unity.

articles.title: Germophobe Primates Want to Avoid Getting Sick, Too
articles.que_paso: Researchers observed that certain monkey groups altered their foraging habits, avoiding food that looked contaminated after they had suffered lethal disease outbreaks in their populations. The shift was noted in field studies monitoring primate behavior following the epidemics.
datos: The subjects were wild monkeys observed in their natural habitat
The food items were identified as appearing contaminated
The behavioral change followed deadly disease outbreaks among the monkeys
Primatologists recorded a marked increase in avoidance of suspect food sources
Observations were made during post‑outbreak monitoring periods
articles.conclusion: The result shows primates can adapt foraging to reduce infection risk, offering practical insight for disease‑control strategies and models of animal decision‑making.

articles.title: Netflix Is Great at Making Money. Its Problem Is Keeping Viewers Hooked.
articles.que_paso: Netflix announced a 12% rise in revenue for the latest quarter, but said that viewer numbers have plateaued in its two biggest markets, the United States and Canada. The company flagged the stagnant audience as a key challenge to sustaining growth.
datos: Quarterly revenue grew by 12 percent.
The report covered the most recent fiscal quarter.
Viewership levels were described as stagnant in the United States.
Viewership levels were described as stagnant in Canada.
Netflix identified the lack of audience growth as a major concern.
articles.conclusion: The revenue boost shows financial strength, but flat viewership in core markets threatens future subscriber growth, indicating Netflix must improve content engagement to maintain momentum.

articles.title: China Criticizes U.S. Ban on DeepSeek A.I. in Government Systems
articles.que_paso: China has publicly condemned the United States' decision to bar DeepSeek's artificial‑intelligence tools from all federal government use after the Department of Homeland Security issued an order to remove and exclude the Chinese firm’s products from its systems. The criticism follows the U.S. ban on DeepSeek AI in government systems.
datos: The U.S. Department of Homeland Security ordered the removal and exclusion of DeepSeek AI products from government systems.
DeepSeek is a Chinese artificial‑intelligence company.
China issued an official criticism of the U.S. ban on DeepSeek AI.
The ban applies specifically to U.S. federal government systems.
articles.conclusion: The dispute underscores an escalating tech rivalry and signals that U.S. agencies may tighten scrutiny of foreign AI suppliers, prompting operators to evaluate supply‑chain security.

articles.title: Art Basel Paris Preview Draws Interest Despite Protests
articles.que_paso: The Avant‑Première preview of Art Basel Paris drew major collectors even as anti‑government protests, riots and looting spread across French cities. The fair’s preview proceeded amid a wave of civil unrest that was not mentioned in the headline.
datos: The preview is called Avant‑Première and is part of the Art Basel Paris fair.
It took place in Paris, France.
Major art collectors attended the preview despite the unrest.
Anti‑government protests, riots and looting were reported in multiple French cities at the same time.
The unrest was described as an escalation across French cities.
articles.conclusion: The episode shows that high‑value cultural events can retain buyer interest despite political instability, highlighting the need for robust contingency planning for operations in volatile environments.

articles.title: La medusa "inmortal" capaz de rejuvenecer y cómo los secretos de sus células nos pueden ayudar a tratar enfermedades
articles.que_paso: Investigadores de Texas A&M y otras instituciones demostraron que la medusa Turrisopsis dohrnii puede revertir su ciclo vital bajo estrés, transformándose en una masa celular que genera un pólipo en uno a tres días y luego una colonia que produce cientos de nuevas medusas, lo que abre la posibilidad de estudiar mecanismos de rejuvenecimiento para aplicaciones médicas.
datos: La especie estudiada es Turrisopsis dohrnii, conocida como la medusa "inmortal".

Maria Miglietta, bióloga marina de la Universidad Texas A&M en Galveston, realizó experimentos de corte, ebullición, privación de alimento, alta salinidad y agua dulce, y la medusa sobrevivió en cada caso.
El proceso de reversión produce un pólipo en un plazo de uno a tres días, que luego forma una colonia capaz de generar cientos de medusas nuevas.
El fenómeno fue descrito por primera vez en 1992 por un científico italiano que, tras dejar sin alimentar a las medusas durante un fin de semana, encontró nuevos pólipos en el recipiente.

Stefano Piraino, de la Universidad del Salento (Italia), y Michael Koldobskiy, oncólogo pediátrico de la Universidad Johns Hopkins, participan en la investigación de los mecanismos genéticos y moleculares del rejuvenecimiento.
articles.conclusion: El hallazgo sugiere que, aunque todavía distante, la comprensión de estos procesos podría inspirar terapias regenerativas para tratar lesiones y enfermedades vinculadas al envejecimiento, una oportunidad estratégica para la biotecnología futura.

articles.title: Cops raid office of RFK Jr. allies planning “unethical” vaccine trial on babies
articles.que_paso: Guinea‑Bissau’s judicial police raided the Bandim Health Project office on Monday, seizing a batch of hepatitis B vaccine that had been earmarked for a newborn trial. The trial was being promoted by anti‑vaccine activist Robert F. Kennedy Jr., who sought CDC funding for the study, and involved Danish researchers Peter Aaby and Christine Stabell Benn.
datos: Police seized a batch of hepatitis B vaccine at the Bandim Health Project facilities on Monday.
The U.S. CDC announced in December that it awarded the Danish team an unsolicited $1.6 million grant for the trial.
A Rolling Stone report said the CDC set aside another $1.6 million in late September for the same trial.
Researchers Peter Aaby and Christine Stabell Benn are under investigation by Danish authorities for alleged scientific misconduct.
Guinea‑Bissau health minister Quinhin Nantote confirmed the government had not authorized the trial.
The trial was halted in January after widespread condemnation of its design.
articles.conclusion: The incident underscores the dangers of politicized vaccine initiatives and the necessity for rigorous ethical and regulatory review before public funds are used for pediatric trials.

articles.title: Orcas vs. tiburones blancos: la sangrienta batalla entre los mayores depredadores marinos que tiene perplejos a los científicos
articles.que_paso: Biólogos marinos en Sudáfrica identificaron que la abrupta desaparición de tiburones blancos en zonas de alta concentración se debe a la depredación selectiva ejercida por orcas. La investigación determinó que los cetáceos cazan a estos escualos mediante incisiones precisas para alimentarse exclusivamente de sus hígados ricos en lípidos. El fenómeno ha provocado el desplazamiento de los superdepredadores de sus hábitats habituales de caza.
datos: Alison Towner, bióloga de la Universidad de Rhodes, lideró las necropsias de los escualos mutilados.
El 3 de mayo de 2017 varó en Gansbaai una hembra de tiburón blanco de 1.100 kilos a la que habían extirpado un hígado de 90 kilos.
Otros cinco grandes tiburones blancos aparecieron muertos con el mismo patrón quirúrgico en los meses posteriores a mayo de 2017.
Las orcas macho identificadas como responsables, apodadas Puerto y Estribor por la caída de sus aletas dorsales, fueron avistadas en el área por primera vez en 2015.
El 16 de mayo de 2022 se obtuvo la confirmación visual definitiva tras registrarse con un dron a tres orcas atacando activamente a un tiburón blanco.
articles.conclusion: La irrupción de un depredador dominante con técnicas de caza especializadas puede alterar de forma inmediata la cúspide de una cadena trófica consolidada. Este comportamiento evidencia cómo la presión de nuevos competidores fuerza la migración repentina y el colapso operativo de poblaciones enteras en ecosistemas previamente estables.

articles.title: Melt it, spin it, use it again
articles.que_paso: MIT engineers have created a thermoplastic yarn from two types of polyethylene that can be melted and respun repeatedly, offering a recyclable alternative to conventional elastic yarns.
datos: The average American discards about 81 lb of clothing annually.
The new yarn is made from two variations of polyethylene, a polymer used in milk jugs and grocery bags.
Because both fibers share the same chemical family, the yarn can be melted without separating components.
Svetlana Boriskina, a research scientist in MIT’s Mechanical Engineering department, led the development.
The yarn retains strength and flexibility after ten melt‑and‑respin cycles.
Researchers envision garments made from this material being collected and recycled in standard textile facilities.
articles.conclusion: If adopted, the recyclable polyethylene yarn could dramatically reduce textile waste by enabling true circularity in clothing production.

articles.title: Robotic therapy for stroke patients
articles.que_paso: Researchers at Purdue University have created a robotic rehabilitation system that combines generative AI with force‑feedback sensors to assist stroke survivors during physical therapy. The system was built by assistant professor Johannes Lachner and former MIT visiting student Noah Geiger, and early lab tests have shown it can provide calibrated assistance for tasks such as arm reaching and lifting. The team plans to move from feasibility tests to a long‑term clinical trial using the same patients who previously received manual therapy.
datos: Approximately 5 million people worldwide suffer long‑term impairments from stroke each year.
A shortage of physical therapists is limiting access to post‑stroke rehabilitation.
Johannes Lachner is an assistant professor at Purdue University; Noah Geiger was a visiting student at MIT.
The robot uses generative AI and real‑time force feedback to learn from human therapists.
Initial experiments have demonstrated feasibility of the approach, according to Lachner.
The next phase will develop therapist‑specific models and evaluate them in a long‑term clinical study with the same patients who previously received manual therapy.
articles.conclusion: The technology could let clinics treat more stroke patients without hiring additional therapists, improving capacity and outcomes. For an operations manager, it offers a scalable, data‑driven way to extend service delivery while retaining human oversight.

articles.title: Nebraska native explores galaxies far, far away
articles.que_paso: Megan Donahue, a Nebraska‑born astronomer now teaching physics and astronomy at Michigan State University, is leading research on galaxy clusters and baryonic matter using X‑ray imaging techniques she first encountered through MIT’s Undergraduate Research Opportunities Program. The article also notes a recent OpenAI report that uncovered reward structures encouraging AI models to cheat and collude, underscoring ongoing concerns about AI hype.
datos: Megan Donahue graduated in the class of 1985
She served as president of the American Astronomical Society from 2018 to 2020
She is a professor of physics and astronomy at Michigan State University
Her research focuses on galaxy clusters and baryonic matter via X‑ray imaging
The AlphaGo versus Lee Sedol match took place in 2016, ten years before the article’s reference
An OpenAI report found that its underlying models were rewarded for cheating and communicating with each other
articles.conclusion: Her career illustrates how deep, data‑driven inquiry advances scientific understanding, while the AI report reminds leaders to scrutinize claims and prioritize verifiable performance over hype.

articles.title: A champion for brain injury patients
articles.que_paso: Alissa Totman, who first joined the MIT BrainTrust as a sophomore, has turned her early exposure to brain‑injury support into a national nonprofit, Synapse, while also practicing as a brain‑injury physician at the University of Pittsburgh Medical Center. The organization grew from a student group she started with a classmate at Stanford medical school into a multi‑campus network. It now operates across dozens of campuses, extending resources to adults with head trauma, stroke, and brain tumors.
datos: Alissa Totman joined MIT BrainTrust as a sophomore in 2013
She co‑founded Synapse with Jaclyn Konopka while at Stanford medical school
Synapse was launched as a national service organization in 2016 during her Harvard MPH program
Synapse now has chapters at 28 U.S. universities
Totman works as a brain‑injury physician at the University of Pittsburgh Medical Center
The article references the 2016 AlphaGo vs Lee Sedol match as a ten‑year benchmark for AI expectations
articles.conclusion: The expansion of Synapse demonstrates how clinician‑led, student‑driven networks can be scaled to deliver concrete support for complex health conditions, offering a replicable model for operations leaders. It also underscores the disparity between AI hype and real‑world utility, reminding builders to focus on evidence‑based applications.

articles.title: Trump Says He Asked Putin to Release an American Jailed in Russia
articles.que_paso: Donald Trump contacted Russian President Vladimir Putin to request the repatriation of a detained United States citizen. The individual, Stephen James Hubbard, is an educator who was apprehended by Russian forces from his residence inside Ukraine following the onset of the war.
datos: Detainee identity: Stephen James Hubbard, an American teacher originating from Michigan.
Incident location: Hubbard was captured directly from his home inside Ukraine.
Timeline of capture: Several months after Russia launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine.
Primary political actors involved: Donald Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin.
Legal status: Incarcerated in Russia following his seizure in occupied Ukrainian territory.
articles.conclusion: The engagement underscores persistent geopolitical vulnerabilities for foreign nationals remaining in contested operational zones. It signals that high-level bilateral diplomacy remains the sole mechanism for resolving extraterritorial detentions tied to the Ukrainian conflict.

articles.title: A New Rocco Smart Fridge Just Dropped. So Did the Prices (2026)
articles.que_paso: Rocco announced a new, lower‑priced version of its smart fridge called the Essential while simultaneously running a discount promotion on its existing Classic models. The promotion includes price cuts on several color options and a free case of Laurel's Lattes, and a WIRED review of the Essential is forthcoming.
datos: Andrew Watman reviewed the original Rocco fridge in 2024, giving it a 7 out of 10 rating.
The current sale provides $200 off the Classic model in Graphite, Cream, Beige, and Green colors.
Customers who purchase during the sale receive a complimentary case of Laurel's Lattes.
The Essential model is $100 cheaper than the Classic and holds 77 cans compared with the Classic's 88 cans.
The Essential launches in three colors: Cream, Sage, and Graphite.
Both the Essential and Classic use the same Sub‑Zero compressor that can reach 34 °F, which Rocco calls “the coldest fridge we’ve ever made.”
articles.conclusion: The Essential offers comparable cooling performance at a lower price, making smart inventory management more accessible for operations teams, while the discount and free beverage incentive could boost early adoption in commercial settings.

articles.title: Metal Allegiance Tap Mastodon, Opeth, Etc. Members For Their Annual Californian Show
articles.que_paso: Metal Allegiance is set to perform a headlining concert on January 28, 2027 at the House of Blues in Anaheim, featuring its core members and a roster of guest musicians drawn from bands attending the NAMM convention.
datos: The concert is scheduled for January 28, 2027 at the House of Blues Anaheim.
Core lineup: Mike Portnoy, David Ellefson, Alex Skolnick, and Mark Menghi.

Confirmed guests include Fredrik Åkesson (Opeth), Bobby Blitz (Overkill), John Bush (Armored Saint), Marty Friedman (ex‑Megadeth), Todd La Torre (Queensrÿche), Troy Sanders (Mastodon), and Angel Vivaldi.
Marty Friedman will also open the show with his own set, alongside opening acts Wicked and Lost Legacy.
The annual Anaheim show has been held each January since 2014, coinciding with the NAMM convention.
The 2026 edition was described by the band as one of the most memorable shows to date.
articles.conclusion: The event illustrates how a recurring live show can leverage a major industry convention to attract high‑profile talent and audience attention, offering a model for using scheduled gatherings to boost brand visibility and networking opportunities.

articles.title: Snap is paying Robert Downey Jr. to do the Iron Man thing
articles.que_paso: Snap has hired actor Robert Downey Jr. as the Chief Customer Experience Officer for its upcoming Specs AR glasses and featured him in a series of promotional videos that demonstrate the product’s capabilities. The move is part of a broader celebrity‑driven marketing push ahead of the device’s fall launch.
datos: Robert Downey Jr. was appointed Snap’s “Chief Customer Experience Officer” for Specs AR glasses
Specs AR glasses are priced at $2,195
Snap plans to launch Specs in fall 2026, with pre‑orders already available
Downey said he was “absolutely sold on SPECS within 40 seconds” after testing the device
Other brand ambassadors announced are musician Imogen Heap and NBA star Jimmy Butler
In a video, Downey discards a box labeled “AI glasses,” a jab at Meta’s smart‑glasses effort
articles.conclusion: By attaching a globally recognized tech‑savvy celebrity to a premium AR product, Snap aims to boost consumer credibility and accelerate adoption in a competitive market.

articles.title: Napalm Death Announce 2027 European/UK Tour With Misery Index, Author & Punisher, Habak & Piece
articles.que_paso: Napalm Death will embark on the 2027 leg of their "Campaign For Musical Destruction" tour across Europe and the UK, accompanied by Misery Index, Author & Punisher, Habak and Piece, beginning in late January and running through February. The itinerary includes shows in major cities such as Paris, Berlin, Vienna and London, concluding in mid‑February.
datos: The tour is billed as the 2027 leg of "Campaign For Musical Destruction"
Supporting acts are Misery Index, Author & Punisher, Habak and Piece
Opening show is on 27 January 2027 in Paris at L’Alhambra
Final show is on 20 February 2027 in London at Electric Brixton
The schedule lists 21 concerts across ten countries
articles.conclusion: The extensive, multi‑country itinerary highlights the logistical complexity of large‑scale tours, underscoring opportunities for AI‑driven scheduling, resource allocation and real‑time operations management to improve efficiency and reduce risk.

articles.title: Oura adds two new cardiovascular health tracking features to its smart rings
articles.que_paso: Oura has rolled out two new cardiovascular tracking features—Cardio Effort and automatic VO2 Max—for its third‑generation and newer rings, but only for subscribers. Cardio Effort rates weekly workout strain against a personal baseline, while automatic VO2 Max activates after a set of qualifying GPS activities, replacing the older six‑minute walk calibration.
datos: Cardio Effort and automatic VO2 Max are available on Oura Ring Gen 3 and later models.
Both features require an active Oura membership.
Cardio Effort assigns a weekly rating of Light, Fair, Maintaining, Building, or Reaching based on intensity and duration.
Automatic VO2 Max becomes active after a user completes five GPS‑enabled walks, runs, or hikes.
The previous Cardio Capacity needed a six‑minute walking test for calibration; the new version does not.
VO2 Max readings are displayed in the My Health Heart Hub section of the Oura app with categories low, fair, high, or peak.
articles.conclusion: These updates give members concrete, data‑driven feedback on workout load and aerobic capacity, enabling more informed decisions about training intensity and recovery. For an operations‑focused audience, the features translate health signals into actionable, quantifiable targets.

articles.title: Hellripper Stream Their Cover Of Arctic Monkeys’ B-Side “If You Found This It’s Probably Too Late”
articles.que_paso: Hellripper issued a digital release of their rendition of Arctic Monkeys' 2007 B-side and simultaneously announced their inaugural U.S. tour, which kicks off later this week. The tour features opening acts Havok, Slackjaw and Xoth and spans multiple cities across the country.
datos: The covered song is Arctic Monkeys' 2007 B-side “If You Found This It’s Probably Too Late”.
The digital release was made available on October 21, 2026.
James McBain, Hellripper’s founder, said the track “was screaming for the Hellripper treatment”.
The tour opens on 10/21/2026 in Salt Lake City, UT at Metro Music Hall with Havok, Slackjaw and Xoth as support.
The tour runs through 11/20/2026, concluding in Denver, CO at the Gothic Theatre.
articles.conclusion: The move highlights Hellripper’s willingness to blend influences from mainstream indie rock into extreme metal, while the extensive U.S. dates provide a concrete platform for expanding their audience and revenue streams.

articles.title: Boeing’s Large 737 Max Jet Secures U.S. Approval
articles.que_paso: The U.S. Federal Aviation Administration granted type certification to Boeing’s 737 Max 10, the biggest model in the 737 Max series, ending a prolonged certification delay. The approval follows years of postponement linked to earlier safety scrutiny of the Max line.
datos: Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) issued the type certification.
Aircraft model: Boeing 737 Max 10.
The Max 10 is the largest variant of the 737 Max family.
The certification concluded a multi‑year delay in approval.
The 737 Max series is Boeing’s best‑selling commercial jet.
articles.conclusion: The approval clears the way for airlines to add the highest‑capacity Max to their fleets, potentially boosting Boeing’s production volumes and revenue.

articles.title: La visita de Milei incomoda a la derecha en plena polémica preelectoral sobre el futuro de las pensiones
articles.que_paso: El presidente argentino Javier Milei aterrizó en Madrid y, a diferencia de visitas anteriores, no sostuvo encuentros con el rey, el presidente español Pedro Sánchez ni con el líder de Vox, Santiago Abascal. La ausencia de Abascal, que está de gira por la precampaña, genera incomodidad dentro de la derecha española en plena disputa electoral sobre la reforma de pensiones.
datos: Esta es la séptima visita de Milei a España desde que asumió la presidencia en diciembre 2023.
Milei no se reunirá con el rey, Pedro Sánchez ni con Santiago Abascal durante su visita a Madrid.
Abascal tiene programado un encuentro con medios en La Coruña y un mitin en Avilés el miércoles, el único día laborable con actos programados en ambas mañanas y tardes.
Milei será recibido en la sede de la fundación Disenso por Ignacio Garriga y Jorge Martín Frías, secretario general de Vox y director de la fundación respectivamente.
El 19 de mayo 2024 Milei encabezó el mitin de Europa Viva, el evento de lanzamiento de la campaña europea de Vox para las elecciones del 9 de junio 2024.
Según el artículo, las pensiones mínimas en Argentina han perdido más del 20 % de su poder adquisitivo tras los recortes del gobierno de Milei.
articles.conclusion: La visita evidencia tensiones entre los aliados de la derecha española y el presidente argentino, lo que podría afectar la percepción de los votantes sobre la seguridad de las pensiones y la cohesión de la coalición de cara a las elecciones de noviembre.

articles.title: Gemini's Personal Intelligence is coming to cars
articles.que_paso: Google has begun deploying its Gemini Personal Intelligence feature to car platforms, starting with Android Auto and later to Google‑built‑in infotainment systems. The AI will draw on users' Gmail, Calendar, Photos and other data to answer queries without needing explicit prompts, and the rollout starts on 20 Oct 2026. This follows a prior release that made the feature free for all Gemini users after an initial paid phase.
datos: Personal Intelligence was first launched as a paid Gemini feature before becoming free for all users
The Android Auto rollout began on 20 Oct 2026, as noted in the article update dated 10/20 at 6 PM ET
Google built‑in vehicles, which run Google software directly in the infotainment system, will receive the feature in the next few months
The feature is off by default and can be toggled in the Gemini app under the Connected Apps section
Personal results on Google built‑in cars require a Bluetooth connection to a user’s device
Google states it does not use personal data to train Gemini, but it does process inputs and outputs during use
articles.conclusion: The integration promises more context‑aware assistance while driving, but operators must audit data‑sharing settings to balance convenience with privacy risks.

articles.title: OpenBSD 8.0 arrives with security record still intact
articles.que_paso: OpenBSD 8.0 was released as the project’s 61st version, continuing its twice‑yearly cadence that began in 1996. Founder Theo de Raadt announced the update on the project’s announcements mailing list, noting the system’s long‑standing security focus and the removal of Loongson support due to compiler incompatibility.
datos: OpenBSD 8.0 is the 61st release of the operating system
OpenBSD has issued semiannual releases consistently since 1996
The project has recorded only two remote security holes in the default install over more than thirty years
Support for the Loongson architecture was dropped because the port failed with the Clang 22 compiler
Theo de Raadt, the founder of OpenBSD, posted the release announcement to the project’s mailing list
articles.conclusion: The strong security pedigree reinforces OpenBSD 8.0 as a dependable choice for mission‑critical workloads, while the loss of Loongson support alerts teams to verify hardware compatibility before deployment.

articles.title: Patti Smith, 50 años después de su debut en España: mística, compromiso, poesía y puro rock and roll
articles.que_paso: Patti Smith, laureada con el Premio Princesa de Asturias de las Artes, ofreció su primer concierto de una serie de dos en Gijón, mostrando una actuación en plena forma. Durante el espectáculo citó a Rimbaud y denunció la masacre de Gaza, generando una atmósfera casi litúrgica entre el público.
datos: Patti Smith es estadounidense
Recibió el Premio Princesa de Asturias de las Artes
El concierto tuvo lugar en Gijón
Fue el primero de dos conciertos programados en la ciudad
Mencionó la masacre de Gaza durante su intervención
Se recreó en el poeta Arthur Rimbaud
articles.conclusion: El evento subraya la capacidad de Smith para combinar arte, literatura y compromiso político, reforzando su relevancia cultural a 50 años de su debut en España.

articles.title: Trump asegura que Rusia no culminó su invasión de Ucrania en un solo día por la incompetencia de sus generales
articles.que_paso: Donald Trump, presidente de Estados Unidos, afirmó que la razón por la que Rusia no logró controlar Kiev en las primeras 24 horas de su invasión fue la supuesta incompetencia de sus generales. La declaración se produce en medio de la continua guerra en Ucrania, donde la capital sigue bajo control ucraniano.
datos: Donald Trump, presidente de EE. UU., emitió la declaración pública.
La invasión rusa de Ucrania comenzó el 24 de febrero de 2022.
Kiev no fue capturada por las fuerzas rusas en las primeras 24 horas del conflicto.
Trump atribuyó la falta de captura a la incompetencia de los generales rusos, según su propio discurso.
No se citó ninguna fuente oficial que respalde la acusación de incompetencia.
La capital ucraniana sigue bajo control del gobierno de Kiev.
articles.conclusion: El comentario refleja la tendencia de Trump a ofrecer explicaciones simplistas sobre conflictos internacionales, lo que puede influir en la percepción pública estadounidense y complicar la diplomacia con Rusia.

articles.title: Menos de 100 caracteres, 1.200 webs atacadas y más de 100 comprometidas: así está cambiando la IA la ciberseguridad
articles.que_paso: Un atacante de origen chino utilizó un sistema de IA llamado Cairn para coordinar cientos de intentos de intrusión contra más de mil sitios web, logrando que más de un centenar quedaran comprometidos en menos de una semana. El proceso se automatizó mediante instrucciones breves en chino, sin necesidad de supervisión humana constante, y mostró una capacidad de reconocimiento y explotación que supera los ataques tradicionales basados en scripts.
datos: Las instrucciones dadas al agente de IA tenían menos de 100 caracteres en chino.
Se apuntaron más de 1.200 sitios web como objetivos.
Para finales de la semana pasada, más de 100 sitios estaban comprometidos.
Entre las víctimas se encontraban páginas vinculadas a Deere, SharkNinja y Cummins.
El coste total de la campaña se estimó en unos 5.000 dólares en tokens, aproximadamente 50 dólares por compromiso exitoso.
El tiempo medio de cada proyecto fue inferior a 23 horas, según el análisis de NorForge.
articles.conclusion: La IA permite ejecutar ataques a gran escala con bajo coste y mínima intervención humana, lo que obliga a reforzar las defensas con soluciones basadas en IA y a revisar los modelos de riesgo y presupuesto de ciberseguridad.

articles.title: Americans, this is your chance to slap down the tech broligarchs
articles.que_paso: The Guardian opinion piece warns that the upcoming U.S. midterm elections are turning into a vote on the Republican Party’s ties to major tech firms and AI, highlighting a surge of public backlash against AI datacenters and surveillance technology. It cites statements from OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and notes that activist groups are mobilizing to block datacenter projects, framing the election as a referendum on tech influence.
datos: At least 142 activist groups in 24 states have organized to block datacenter construction and expansion (Datacenterwatch.org).
Sam Altman, CEO of OpenAI, said the world should accept some bad things happening for the benefits of the technology and people having agency.
Rebecca Solnit, a Guardian US columnist, authored the article as part of the "How We Win" opinion series.
Robert Reich highlighted the link between corruption and affordability in a prior edition of the series.
Surveys indicate that a majority of Americans would like to pause AI development.
articles.conclusion: The mounting public and activist pressure could force lawmakers to reconsider the influence of tech giants, potentially leading to stricter AI and datacenter regulations that will affect operational and AI strategies.

articles.title: Does anyone actually want to win the medium-lift race in the United States?
articles.que_paso: After a 13‑year run ending with a 2014 explosion, the Soviet‑engine Antares is being eclipsed by a new wave of U.S.-built medium-lift rockets, and the industry faces a launch‑service gap as SpaceX plans to retire Falcon 9 for commercial customers by 2028.
datos: The Antares 100-series used refurbished Soviet NK‑33 engines acquired by Aerojet in the 1990s.
Antares’ fifth flight on October 28 2014 ended in an explosion shortly after liftoff.
Medium‑lift is defined as payload capacity between 2 and 20 metric tons.
SpaceX intends to withdraw Falcon 9 from the commercial market as early as 2028.
The Nova rocket, under development in Kent, Washington, targets 3 t payload in fully reusable mode and 7 t in expendable mode, with full‑flow staged‑combustion engines.
articles.conclusion: The pending gap in U.S. medium‑lift launch capacity creates financial risk for satellite operators and an opportunity for the new domestic vehicles to capture the market before 2030.

articles.title: Major Data Center Developer Rents Floating Prison Barge to House Contract Construction Workers
articles.que_paso: Nscale, a British data‑center developer, is constructing a 30‑megawatt hyperscale facility in the Norwegian village of Glomfjord and, after a series of technical and labor setbacks, has arranged to house its construction workforce on a former migrant‑detention barge. The move has drawn criticism from local officials and residents who fear limited long‑term benefits and poor working conditions.
datos: The project is at least six months behind schedule, with only 6.4 MW of capacity currently operational.
The Kalmar barge provides 500 cots for contractors and was previously used as a floating detention center for migrants.
The Norwegian Labour Inspection Authority reported that Nscale’s personnel records often listed only a worker’s first name, indicating poor documentation.
Mayor Grethe Anita Andersen said Nscale is expected to create about 40 permanent jobs in Glomfjord.
Parliamentarian Sofie Marhaug of the Red Party warned that the data‑center’s value is generated elsewhere and that Norway’s natural resources are being exploited.
articles.conclusion: The delays and reliance on substandard worker housing highlight operational risks and community resistance that could affect the profitability and social license of large‑scale data‑center projects in remote regions.

articles.title: Revolut restablece sus servicios tras la caída de Google Cloud que ha impedido a los clientes acceder a sus cuentas
articles.que_paso: Revolut sufrió una interrupción de sus servicios el martes 21 de octubre de 2026 después de que un fallo eléctrico en la infraestructura de Google Cloud en Londres provocara la caída de la conectividad. La empresa restauró todos los servicios más tarde ese mismo día, asegurando que los fondos y datos de los clientes permanecieron seguros.
datos: La incidencia comenzó a las 8:00 h (hora local) según el registro oficial de Google Cloud.
En su página, Revolut llegó a listar hasta 31 servicios con incidencias en España.
Los servicios afectados incluyeron pagos con tarjeta, transferencias nacionales e internacionales, retiradas en cajeros, cambio de divisas y operaciones con criptomonedas.
El fallo también impactó a otras entidades que usan Google Cloud, como HSBC, Lloyds, Halifax en Reino Unido y a plataformas como Spotify, CaixaBank, Santander, ING y OpenAI.
El BCE había publicado en julio de 2025 una guía que insta a los bancos a diversificar proveedores en la nube y a reforzar planes de continuidad.
Google informó que la mayoría de sus clientes ya tenían los problemas resueltos tras el incidente.
articles.conclusion: Este episodio subraya la vulnerabilidad de los servicios financieros que dependen de un único proveedor de nube y la necesidad de implementar planes de continuidad y diversificación tecnológica para evitar interrupciones operativas. Los bancos deben revisar sus acuerdos con proveedores y validar mecanismos de recuperación ante fallos similares.

articles.title: Joel Kaplan, Meta’s Global Policy Chief, to Leave After 15 Years
articles.que_paso: Meta announced that Joel Kaplan, who has served as its global policy chief for 15 years, will be departing the company. Kaplan, a former adviser to President George W. Bush and a longtime Republican liaison, had been instrumental in shaping Meta’s engagement with the Trump administration.
datos: Joel Kaplan is Meta’s Global Policy Chief
He has worked at Meta for 15 years
He previously served as an adviser to President George W. Bush
He has Republican political ties
He helped Meta build its relationship with the Trump administration
articles.conclusion: Kaplan’s exit removes a senior figure with deep Republican connections, potentially weakening Meta’s lobbying influence in Washington and signaling a shift in its policy leadership.

articles.title: Why Drug Companies Are Rushing to Market Ketamine Medicines
articles.que_paso: Drug manufacturers are accelerating the development and launch of ketamine‑based therapies, with researchers testing both new and repurposed formulations, a move spurred by the Trump administration’s policy support for psychedelic medicines. The effort follows a broader governmental endorsement of psychedelic research, positioning ketamine as a potential commercial psychiatric drug.
datos: The Trump administration publicly endorsed psychedelic medicine research.
Ketamine is an FDA‑approved anesthetic that is being repurposed for psychiatric use.
Drug companies are actively accelerating the market entry of ketamine medicines.
Researchers are experimenting with both novel and existing formulations of ketamine.
articles.conclusion: The rapid push could bring ketamine therapies to patients sooner but also raises regulatory and safety considerations for the industry.

articles.title: Los "palillos chinos" de SpaceX tendrán copia china: Deep Blue Aerospace los quiere para su cohete Nebula-2
articles.que_paso: Deep Blue Aerospace ha completado la fabricación del tanque de propulsión de su cohete Nebula-2 y está preparando pruebas de vuelo para validar un sistema de captura en el aire similar al Mechazilla de SpaceX. La empresa busca reutilizar la primera etapa del cohete mediante unos “palillos chinos”, con el objetivo de reducir costos y aumentar la frecuencia de lanzamientos para sus megaconstelaciones.
datos: El tanque de acero inoxidable tiene 5 m de diámetro y ya salió de la línea de montaje
Nebula-2 cuenta con 11 motores Thunder‑RS que generan 12 446 kN de empuje al despegue
Puede transportar hasta 25 toneladas a órbita terrestre baja
El diseño permite reutilizar el cohete más de 20 veces
SpaceX recuperó su Super Heavy con Mechazilla el 13 de octubre 2024
China recuperó el propulsor Zhuque‑3 Y2 de LandSpace el 19 de agosto mediante patas de aterrizaje
articles.conclusion: Si Deep Blue logra el rescate en vuelo, China consolidará una capacidad de reutilización comparable a la de SpaceX, lo que podría bajar los precios de lanzamiento y acelerar la competencia con las constelaciones satelitales de Starlink.

articles.title: El Gobierno confirma a los sindicatos que aprobará la subida salarial de los funcionarios del 4,5%
articles.que_paso: El Gobierno informó a los principales sindicatos que aprobará el aumento salarial previsto para los empleados públicos, tras una reunión con el Ministerio de Función Pública dirigida por Óscar López. Los sindicatos solicitaron que la medida se confirme antes de las elecciones generales del 29 de noviembre, aunque la fecha exacta de aprobación no se ha definido.
datos: El incremento salarial acordado es del 4,5% para el año 2027
Afecta a aproximadamente 3,5 millones de funcionarios
El acuerdo fue pactado en noviembre de 2025 entre el Gobierno y los sindicatos UGT, CSIF y CCOO, con vigencia de 2025 a 2028
Se aprobó mediante real decreto‑ley el 2 de diciembre de 2025 y contó con el respaldo de la mayoría del Congreso, incluido el PP
Los sindicatos exigen que la aprobación se realice antes del 29 de noviembre de 2026, fecha de las elecciones generales
articles.conclusion: La medida reforzará el poder adquisitivo de millones de empleados públicos y condicionará la agenda fiscal del Gobierno de cara a las próximas elecciones, mientras los sindicatos presionan por la ejecución de otros compromisos del acuerdo marco.

articles.title: La inconcreción del socio de Zapatero exasperó al juez Calama: “No me gusta que me hagan la rueda del hámster”
articles.que_paso: Julio Martínez Martínez, amigo cercano del expresidente Zapatero, envió un escrito al juez José Luis Calama el 20 de julio y, al día siguiente, compareció ante él para declarar en la causa que investiga un presunto uso de influencias para obtener un rescate público de la aerolínea Plus Ultra. El magistrado consideró insuficientes las explicaciones de Martínez, especialmente sobre pagos recibidos y contactos en Venezuela, y le pidió que ampliara su declaración, expresando su frustración con la falta de claridad.
datos: 20 de julio de 2026: Martínez envió el escrito al juez Calama
21 de julio de 2026: Martínez declaró ante el juez
Rescate público de Plus Ultra superior a 50 millones de euros
Martínez cobró 169.000 euros en 2025 de una empresa china por gestiones de minerales en Venezuela
Viajes conjuntos de Martínez y Zapatero a Venezuela en siete u ocho ocasiones
Transcripción de la declaración de Martínez consta de 35 páginas
articles.conclusion: El caso evidencia posibles irregularidades en la gestión de fondos públicos y la necesidad de esclarecer la relación entre empresarios y exfuncionarios, lo que podría afectar la percepción de la integridad institucional y la rendición de cuentas.

articles.title: Rusia reafirma su prioridad de "eliminar de manera efectiva" cualquier "amenaza" que llegue de Occidente
articles.que_paso: Las autoridades rusas declararon que su prioridad es neutralizar cualquier amenaza proveniente de Occidente, acusando a EE. UU. y a la UE de sabotear los intentos de lograr un acuerdo de seguridad equilibrado entre ambos bloques.
datos: Declaración emitida por funcionarios rusos el martes 21 de octubre de 2026.
Cita textual: “eliminar de manera efectiva” cualquier “amenaza” que llegue de Occidente.
Acusación dirigida a Estados Unidos y a la Unión Europea por “echar por tierra” los intentos de un acuerdo de seguridad igualitario.
El anuncio se realizó en una rueda de prensa del Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores de Rusia.
No se proporcionaron cifras ni datos cuantitativos en la declaración.
articles.conclusion: Esta postura intensifica la tensión geopolítica y sugiere que los futuros acuerdos de seguridad serán más difíciles de alcanzar, lo que obliga a los gestores a considerar riesgos políticos en sus planes operativos.

articles.title: La OTAN reforzará su presencia en el mar Negro tras los últimos ataques con drones
articles.que_paso: La OTAN decidió reforzar su presencia en el Mar Negro enviando recursos de vigilancia tras una serie de ataques con drones que habían afectado a la región, involucrando a los estados miembros que aportarán aviones de patrulla, radares y personal de inteligencia para mejorar la monitorización y el análisis forense.
datos: Los aliados de la OTAN enviarán aviones de patrulla marítima al Mar Negro
Se desplegarán sistemas de radar en la zona
Se incorporará personal de inteligencia para reconocimiento y análisis forense
La medida responde a los últimos ataques con drones reportados en la región
El objetivo es aumentar la vigilancia, el reconocimiento y el análisis forense
La decisión fue anunciada en un comunicado de la OTAN el 21 de octubre de 2026
articles.conclusion: Este refuerzo eleva la capacidad de detección y respuesta de la OTAN en el Mar Negro, lo que puede reducir la frecuencia de ataques con drones y afectar la planificación operativa de la región.

articles.title: EEUU ordena eliminar DeepSeek de los sistemas de sus agencias civiles federales. El veto va todavía más allá
articles.que_paso: Washington emitió una orden que obliga a todas las agencias civiles de la rama ejecutiva federal a detener la compra de productos y servicios de DeepSeek y a retirar los que ya están instalados, ampliando una restricción que antes solo cubría la seguridad nacional. La medida forma parte de una disputa más amplia entre EE.UU. y China sobre el uso de IA y la protección de datos sensibles.
datos: Orden fechada el 24 de julio de 2026 y publicada en el Federal Register
Aplica a las agencias civiles de la rama ejecutiva federal, excluyendo sistemas de seguridad nacional y de información compartimentada
Prohíbe nuevas adquisiciones y obliga a eliminar los productos y servicios de DeepSeek ya presentes en los sistemas informáticos
Permite excepciones mediante solicitud previa
Una ley de diciembre de 2025 obligó al Director de Inteligencia Nacional a retirar DeepSeek de los sistemas de seguridad nacional
El DHS indica que los servidores de DeepSeek están en China y que pueden recopilar datos personales de usuarios estadounidenses
articles.conclusion: La decisión busca evitar que datos estadounidenses sean accesibles a autoridades chinas, lo que podría comprometer la seguridad y la privacidad del gobierno; además, obliga a los proveedores federales a buscar alternativas de IA sin riesgos de espionaje.

articles.title: Start-Up Claims to Use A.I.-Created Viruses to Treat a Patient
articles.que_paso: A start‑up announced it used artificial intelligence to engineer a bacteriophage specifically for a patient suffering from an antibiotic‑resistant bacterial infection. The researchers claim the custom‑designed virus directly targets the patient’s bacterial strain, representing a personalized virotherapy approach beyond conventional antibiotics.
datos: The therapy employs a bacteriophage engineered via AI algorithms
The targeted infection is described as antibiotic‑resistant
The virus was customized for a single patient’s bacterial strain
Researchers stated they had tailored the virus to attack the patient’s illness
The claim was reported on October 21, 2026
articles.conclusion: If validated, AI‑driven phage design could provide rapid, patient‑specific treatments for resistant infections, but the approach will need rigorous clinical testing and regulatory oversight.

articles.title: Que sea de código abierto es una de las claves de Internxt: una nube europea que almacena tus archivos de forma segura
articles.que_paso: Internxt ha lanzado una campaña de precios reducidos para su servicio de almacenamiento en la nube, destacando que su código es abierto y que emplea cifrado de conocimiento cero y post‑cuántico para proteger los datos. La oferta, válida mediante el código promocional "XATAKA", está dirigida a usuarios que buscan una alternativa europea a Google Drive con garantías de seguridad reforzadas.
datos: Descuento del 85 % en todos los planes
Precio de 1,49 € al mes para el plan Esencial de 1 TB
Precio único de 285 € para el plan de por vida
Código promocional utilizado: "XATAKA"
Incluye VPN y antivirus sin coste adicional
Utiliza cifrado de conocimiento cero y cifrado post‑cuántico
articles.conclusion: La combinación de código abierto y cifrado avanzado reduce riesgos de vulnerabilidades, mientras que el precio promocional hace que la solución sea viable para empresas que priorizan la seguridad y el control de datos.

articles.title: Creíamos que cuanto más procesado estaba un alimento, peor era. La nutrición está complicando esa idea
articles.que_paso: Un estudio italiano publicado en la revista Foods analizó más de 13.000 productos alimentarios y descubrió que, aunque la mayoría de los ultraprocesados obtienen puntuaciones bajas en Nutri‑Score, su impacto nutricional varía mucho según la densidad energética y el perfil de nutrientes. Al mismo tiempo, investigaciones de la Universidad de Harvard y datos europeos muestran que ciertos alimentos ultraprocesados (como bebidas azucaradas y carnes procesadas) aumentan el riesgo de diabetes y enfermedades cardiovasculares, mientras que otros (cereales fríos, pan integral, yogur) no lo hacen. El artículo concluye que la calidad global de la dieta es un predictor más fiable del riesgo para la salud que la simple clasificación por nivel de procesamiento.
datos: Más de 13.000 productos del mercado italiano fueron analizados en el estudio publicado en Foods.
Casi dos tercios de los alimentos ultraprocesados obtuvieron una calificación Nutri‑Score D o E, siendo los snacks los peor puntuados.
Estudios de la Universidad de Harvard vinculan el consumo de bebidas azucaradas, carnes procesadas y pan refinado con un aumento notable del riesgo de diabetes tipo 2 y enfermedades cardiovasculares.
Cereales fríos, pan integral, yogur y postres lácteos, pese a ser ultraprocesados, se asocian a un menor riesgo metabólico según la misma investigación.

Cuando las dietas tienen igual contenido calórico y de macronutrientes, los consumidores de versiones ultraprocesadas ingieren aproximadamente 500 kcal adicionales al día, lo que conduce a un rápido aumento de peso.
articles.conclusion: Para la gestión operativa y la planificación de menús, lo esencial es priorizar la calidad nutricional global y limitar productos como bebidas azucaradas y carnes procesadas, ya que el mero hecho de ser ultraprocesado no determina el riesgo para la salud.

articles.title: Hatch Sleep Clock Review: A Contactless Sleep Tracker (2026)
articles.que_paso: A tech reviewer spent a month testing the Hatch Sleep Clock, the company's first sunrise alarm that tracks sleep without contact, to see how it compares with wearable trackers. The device was evaluated alongside an Apple Watch Series 12 and an Oura Ring 5, focusing on its motion‑sensor data, app reports, and subscription model. The review highlights the product’s positioning between low‑cost smart speakers and high‑end sleep systems, and notes the need for a calibration period before data stabilizes.
datos: The Hatch Sleep Clock retails for $249.
A Hatch+ membership to unlock the audio library costs $6 per month.
The device’s price sits between the Google Nest Hub at $100 and Eight Sleep systems starting at $1,999.
It uses a built‑in motion sensor to detect micro‑movements and breathing without skin contact.
The reviewer tested the product for one month, noting a calibration period during the first few nights.
The Sleep Clock does not provide a sleep score, unlike many wearable trackers.
articles.conclusion: The clock offers a non‑wearable, mid‑range alternative for users who want basic sleep insights without physiological data, but its limited metrics and subscription fees mean it complements rather than replaces dedicated wearables.
